title: ScholarChain entity-resolution LLM adjudication response (er-adjudication-response-v1)
description: Strict output schema for bounded LLM adjudication. Enforced by scholarchain.er.adjudication.AdjudicationSchema.parse. Additional run-time rules not expressible here: every candidateIds entry must be one of the request's allowedCandidateIds (an invented ID is rejected), every citedFields entry must be one of the request's allowedCitedFields, and citedFields must be non-empty for ACCEPT and REJECT.
